searchText: The invalid transactions are a bit annoying in my case because I consume transactions from JSON so validation of that is a bit fake. But I can leave with it. In your opinion we should keep both formats forever and maybe remove/deprecated "transaction tests"? Yes, probably keep them

The invalid transactions are a bit annoying in my case because I consume transactions from JSON so validation of that is a bit fake. But I can leave with it.

In your opinion we should keep both formats forever and maybe remove/deprecated "transaction tests"?
